-- intro: True Briar Magic: Queen of Briars is a Briar Magic spell.
-- Description:
    The user creates a natural mana array that generates real roses, and then wraps themselves in a dress and crown made of briars, with blue roses on the right side and red roses on the left side. The user also creates a briar whip which can strike opponents with vines of red roses or wrap an opponent in blue roses. The stronger a victim is, the tighter the blue rose vines are.
